name: CreateSharedMailbox
label: Create Shared Mailbox
helpText: Creates a shared mailbox with the configured display name and primary email address, then blocks sign-in for its Entra account. Add one instance per shared mailbox the baseline should guarantee. Drifts when no mailbox with that address exists in the tenant. Tenant tokens such as %defaultdomain% are supported in the address.
executiveText: Guarantees that the standard shared mailboxes (for example info@ or support@) exist in every tenant, created with sign-in blocked so they can only be reached through delegated access.
docsDescription: One instance per shared mailbox. The standard grades whether a mailbox with the configured primary email address exists, matched case-insensitively against the primary SMTP address and the user principal name in the cached mailbox list. Remediation creates the shared mailbox with New-Mailbox, waits three seconds for the directory object to settle, then disables the mailbox's Entra account through Microsoft Graph. An existing mailbox is never modified.
